comments.text:
Env311 - if possible avoid Mdo
Mdo ugh just a waste of 20K Tk. Not good for learning. Sometimes okay conducting lectures and most of the time not, showing a lack of consistency. Disaster situation if it's an online class as he mostly will just come, take attendance, provide all sorts of excuses and end the class.
For mid, he will be giving 10 lectures which have a lot of topics, but alas he will only be giving questions from 2/3 topics that too broad. And he didn't mention anything about question types in class. Also, he gave a math question that I didn't even learn in class.
About attendance, every time someone comes late, he starts providing lecture.
ENV311 is an easy course. And under him, you should be more dependent on self-study as he won't be able to properly guide you through the course.
Try to oil him as much as you can to increase your grade as he does provide unfair marking. And he also doesn't have proper marking criteria.

comments.label: Comment by Sadia Islam Dia 21 weeks ago
comments.text:
ENV373 - Eaa shera, good with his teaching, organised, cooperative, supportive and a very caring person.
He highlights the important topics from the slide to study and the questions come from there. He tells the question pattern (mcq, short questions & maths are usually present). And the course itself is easy and if you want to make it a bit challenging do your research with the reports that interest you.
About the presentation, each member has to do their own work. Don't do it, you will lose your own marks. And honestly, loved his instructions providing fair and equal opportunity to everyone reducing conflict and supremacy among teammates. And in the report, if there are issues, he will give you time to fix them.
He is the best env fac I have among all the env courses. It's also better to see him keep reserved for Civil and Environmental students for ENV107 as fac like him are much needed.
He is a thousand times better than fac likes Ark, Mdo etc.
